Return the EXACT ordered execution path inside this function ONLY, as a list of objects with keys `file`, `func`, and `line`, INCLUDING repeated lines (every Python `line` event). Control-flow rules to simulate: (a) line 205 sets `pattern = r"(\$|&){[a-zA-Z0-9\.:]+}"`. (b) line 206 evaluates `re.search(pattern, s)`; the early-return at line 207 is taken iff that match is None. The crafted `s` DOES match, so 207 is NOT visited. (c) line 209 deepcopies `s` into `new_s`. (d) line 210 is the `for k, v in params.items()` head; it is RE-VISITED once per iteration (loop continuations land on this line again). (e) line 211 evaluates `isinstance(v, dict)`; when truthy, the multi-line statement at 212-216 computes the md5-digest hex fragment. CPython tracing typically emits ONE line event at line 212 for the start of that compound expression and may also emit events on the continuation lines (213-216). When `isinstance` is FALSE, lines 212-216 are SKIPPED entirely. (f) lines 217 and 218 (the two `re.sub` calls) ALWAYS execute on every iteration regardless of the dict branch. (g) after the for loop exits, line 220 evaluates `isinstance(s, str_node)`. The crafted input is a plain `str`, so line 221 is NOT visited. (h) line 223 is the final `return`. Note: `params` iterates in INSERTION order (Python 3.7+). Return the answer under the field `executed_path`.
